decisions.limitation: Errors in long sentences  (weakness of: RelForge: Neural Relation Extraction for Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction)
decisions.evidence: SubGround retrieves a query-specific subgraph before a Large Language Model writes an answer.

decisions.limitation: Difficult entity boundaries  (weakness of: RelForge: Neural Relation Extraction for Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction)
decisions.evidence: A Graph Neural Network scores nodes and edges in a Knowledge Graph, selecting a compact set of explicit facts.

decisions.limitation: Confidence calibration needed  (weakness of: RelForge: Neural Relation Extraction for Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction)
decisions.evidence: Each selected fact retains its source passage and identifier.

decisions.limitation: Main limitation is multi-hop composition  (weakness of: Retrieve-then-Generate: Augmenting Language Models with Retrieved Passages for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks)
decisions.evidence: SubGround improves Multi-hop QA and materially advances Hallucination Reduction.

decisions.limitation: Diminishing returns on multi-hop questions  (weakness of: Retrieve-then-Generate: Augmenting Language Models with Retrieved Passages for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks)
decisions.evidence: The gain is largest when the answer requires two or three linked facts.

decisions.limitation: Requires better evidence planning  (weakness of: Retrieve-then-Generate: Augmenting Language Models with Retrieved Passages for Knowledge-Intensive Tasks)
decisions.evidence: SubGround uses a Knowledge Graph to make this evidence explicit.

decisions.limitation: Remains above zero error rate  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)
decisions.evidence: Failures mainly arise when the needed relation is absent from the Knowledge Graph.

decisions.limitation: Does not eliminate unsupported claims  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)
decisions.evidence: The system reports both answer quality and unsupported-span rate, separating retrieval failures from generation failures.

decisions.limitation: Requires continued work on verification  (weakness of: FactProbe: A Benchmark for Measuring Hallucination in Large Language Models)
decisions.evidence: Future work should combine structured and textual evidence without losing traceability.
